configuration.compatibility_change: Passed null OUTLINE_ERROR_HANDLER before the allow-arcs boolean to match the KiCad 9 GetBoardPolygonOutlines overload. Resolved swig_compat import against the pinned checkout.
configuration.result: Normalized source and retained routed reference; stripped tracks, vias and copper zones, retained rule areas; rebuilt Edge.Cuts and removed non-routing board graphics. Original PCB and project retained under source/. Source rules and placements were not edited.

scope: Find and stage alternatives only; no routing benchmark or tier promotion. Error-level KiCad DRC with unmodified source project and no exclusions. Expected stripped-board unconnected items are counted separately.
